name: ptee-prednat-donottrack-external
title: Guard the front door: preDNAT and doNotTrack
summary: Two host-firewall switches built for the outside world. preDNAT blocks an external source at the node's edge *before* kube-proxy rewrites the destination - so you match the real client, not a service VIP. doNotTrack runs statelessly in the raw table for host-networked servers. Both key off the source CIDR, which survives DNAT untouched.
